correctness.rationale: The parity-check matrix has local row supports in three four-column blocks and bottom triples V_1,V_2,V_3 from Fu–Shan. Every erasure pattern has completion kernel dimension |E|−rank(H_E). With d=5 all four-subsets are independent. The exact GF(5) five-column dependence census gives 16 circuits, and the exhaustive six-subset rank census gives 181 deficient rank-five sets (and none of rank≤4), of which 112 extend a five-circuit; the residual 69 are minimal six-circuits. Thus each failed pattern has precisely 5 completions. Independent check: Independently reconstructed the six-by-twelve matrix from the explicit V_i over F_5, exhaustively row-reduced all 792 five-subsets and 924 six-subsets: histograms for nullity at k=5 were 776 rank-full and 16 nullity-one, and k=6 were 743 rank-full and 181 nullity-one. Independently extracted 16 five-circuits/69 six-circuits; maximum intersection of distinct five-circuits was three. This is truly exhaustive for the claimed finite code, not a sample.
residual_risks: Exact counts are restricted to the specified normalization of one code and not proved invariant across every strong-Pasch choice.
